title: DAX Zero to Advanced
subtitle: From SUM to TREATAS — real enterprise patterns from production dashboards.

lessons.title: What Is DAX and Why It Matters
lessons.description: Understand the DAX engine, how it relates to the Power BI data model, and why most beginners start wrong.

lessons.title: Row Context vs Filter Context
lessons.description: The single concept that unlocks everything else in DAX. We build mental models, not just formulas.

lessons.title: CALCULATE — The Most Important Function
lessons.description: How CALCULATE modifies filter context and why it appears in nearly every advanced measure.

lessons.title: SUM, SUMX and the Iterator Pattern
lessons.description: Aggregators vs iterators — when to use each and why SUMX is often the right call.

lessons.title: Time Intelligence: DATESYTD, DATESMTD
lessons.description: Build year-to-date, quarter-to-date, and period-over-period comparisons cleanly.

lessons.title: RANKX and Dynamic Ranking
lessons.description: Rank products, salespeople, or regions dynamically — tied ranks, dense ranking, and all edge cases.

lessons.title: Variables and RETURN
lessons.description: Write readable, debuggable DAX with VAR/RETURN. Eliminate repeated calculations.

lessons.title: FILTER, ALL and Context Transition
lessons.description: Master ALL, ALLEXCEPT, and ALLSELECTED. Understand context transition inside CALCULATE.

lessons.title: TREATAS and Virtual Relationships
lessons.description: When the data model can't have a physical relationship, TREATAS creates a virtual one in DAX.

lessons.title: Dynamic Segmentation with SWITCH
lessons.description: Build customer tiers, price bands, and performance brackets that respond to slicer selections.

lessons.title: CROSSFILTER and Bidirectional Relationships
lessons.description: Control filter propagation direction in DAX — understand the risks of many-to-many and when to use it.

lessons.title: Performance Tuning with DAX Studio
lessons.description: Read storage engine and formula engine query plans. Find and fix slow measures in production.
